build: echo 'MAKE sure you already build the linux version of cyfs-gateway (result store in web3-gateway/)'
start: sudo mkdir -p /opt/buckyos/etc /opt/buckyos/logs/web3_gateway && sudo cp /opt/web3-gateway/etc/machine.json /opt/buckyos/etc/machine.json && sudo sh -c 'pgrep -x web3_gateway >/dev/null || setsid -f python3 /opt/web3-gateway/start.py >> /opt/buckyos/logs/web3_gateway/start.log 2>&1'
